description: Which official CrossInk commit each FrotzX3 release is built against. Newest first, except that entries marked opt_in_only are never chosen by default. Only mark an entry tested (and drop opt_in_only) after regression and XTEINK X3 hardware testing; a clean patch or a successful compile is not enough.

releases.notes: Port of FrotzX3 0.9.0-beta.1 to CrossInk v1.6.1. Reconstructs and compiles from official source, but NO firmware from this package has been flashed or tested on an X3. Never selected by default; request it explicitly with Install-FrotzX3.ps1 -TargetCrossInkVersion 1.6.1. Not the public default; the prebuilt release firmware (old base) remains the hardware-tested artifact.

releases.crossink_version: 1.5.0 + 3 commits (platformio.ini version 1.5.0; no release tag at this commit, it lies between v1.5.0 and v1.5.1)
releases.firmware_tested_source: a045d1fd (monolithic repository build; runtime code unchanged since)
releases.notes: The prebuilt release firmware is the hardware-tested artifact. Firmware produced by the patch installer has not itself been flashed and tested on an X3.
